heritage.principle: Reuse addressability, consumption, descendant, multi-consumer and structural-exposure logic; add only heterogeneous native-surface adapters.

rules.trigger: same addressable object observed by >=2 distinct actors
same addressable object observed >=3 times with a non-adjacent re-entry
an application object is written/materialized and later consumed again
an immutable RAG/memory/compression carrier is repeatedly exposed
a native compression/context transformation changes the recorded carrier
turn-budget termination retains pending roles while an addressable object has repeated support

normalization.X1: AutoGen native event stream -> tools/messages/handoffs/addressable objects
normalization.X2: MetaGPT environment/role-memory copies -> message identity and cross-role reuse
normalization.X3: A2A JSON-RPC role-call payloads -> sender/target/message and referenced application objects
normalization.X4: MCP wire tool calls -> native tool/action and application object refs
normalization.X5: RAG query/hit observer -> immutable retrieval-hit content addresses with host-turn actor mapping
normalization.X6: MemoryBank query/recall/state observer -> immutable recall/state content addresses with host-turn actor mapping
normalization.X7: LongLLMLingua input/output observer -> context transformation and host-turn actor mapping

repairability.application_file: native write/revision surface may be nominated if originally exposed
repairability.native_message_or_task: superseding new native message/task may be nominated; historical payloads are immutable

non_claims: Repeated retrieval or memory is not automatically a defect.
Compression transformation is not automatically harmful.
A monitor candidate is not automatically repair-eligible.
The monitor does not use semantic-audit answers.
